summary: Frontend-only validation of Cotizaciones wizard + DirectProjectCreation for (A) hidden 'MPOS (Tablet/Móvil)' entry, (B) dynamic integrator filtering by integration_type, and (C) [PG]/[LP]/[TK] badges only for gateway/link projects. All 3 requirements verified end-to-end via Playwright against the live preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Nice: filtering + badge logic centralized in src/utils/integratorModality.js and reused by both QuoteWizardDialog.jsx and DirectProjectCreation.jsx – single source of truth. Behavior matches PROJECT_TYPE_INTEGRATION map exactly (CR/MP/PG/LP+TK).

MPOS entry kept in QUOTE_TYPES with disabled:true and filtered via .filter(t=>!t.disabled) – acceptable soft-hide; consider fully removing later once no legacy quote_type='MPOS' documents remain, otherwise old quotes/lists may still show it in read-only surfaces.

Console shows a pre-existing (unrelated) hydration warning on /quotes page: <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapping a <tr> inside <tbody> in QuotesTable.jsx (~line 289). Not caused by this change, but worth cleaning up separately.
seed_data_creation: None. Only opened forms and read dropdowns (no data mutated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both wizard (data-testid=select-quote-type + select-integrator) and DirectProjectCreation (dp-quote-type + dp-integrator) now correctly (i) hide MPOS Tablet/Móvil in the wizard, (ii) filter integrators by integration_type via integratorModalityMatch, and (iii) show [PG]/[LP]/[TK] suffix only for GATEWAY/LINK_PAGO projects (VPOS and MPOS Imple+POS show clean names). Counts observed in current DB: PG=132 names, CR=154, MP=13, LP+TK=13. To reproduce: login admin → /quotes → Implementaciones → Clientes Pymes → choose any client → cycle Tipo de Cotización and open Integrador; then /direct-projects → cycle dp-quote-type and open dp-integrator. LINK_PAGO in the wizard triggers an AlertDialog variant selector (Link de Pago / Tokenizador / ambos) which needs the 'Continuar' button clicked before subsequent quote_type changes are possible.
rca of the issue: N/A – no bug reproduced. All acceptance criteria in the review request met.
